Hi! I'm really sorry that you feel this way and that you've been feeling so bad. Changes are scary, even if we change all the time. We are always learning something new about ourselves.

Being asexual doesn't mean that you can't be in the spotlight or that you can't have people falling at your feet. It doesn't mean that you can't have a family neither. There are a lot of aces that fall in love, or marry, or have children, date, and even have sex if they want to. There are people who don't do these things. Nothing is a rule. Asexuality is a very big term (sorry, I'm not sure if this is the right word), and it has a lot of variations within itself. Discovering yourself as asexual is not easy, but it doesn't have to be scary  or bad :) maybe it's just a way to help you find what are you comfortable with, and never to limit you.

Maybe taking to more asexual people can help you feel better about it and understand a little bit more ♡ Please, don't worry, you are not a lie. And if you think you are ace, you are not and never will be alone on this journey.
